name: Claws of the Bear
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, ranger 1, bloodrager 1, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (an animal’s claw)

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration 1 hour/ level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Bestial claws emerge from your flesh at will. This spell grants the caster the ability to manifest and dismiss claws as a free action. These claws deal 1d6 slashing damage and function as primary natural weapons. For every three caster levels the claws gain a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls to a maximum of +5 at 15th level. If the caster makes a full attack and damages a target with both claws they may make a grapple check as a free action. If this grapple check is successful the target takes damage from one claw in addition to gaining the grappled condition.
